tasks.title: Implement expression evaluator and numeric engine
tasks.work_unit: AST-based evaluation of calculator tokens with tagged rational/real/complex values, precedence grammar, scientific/fraction/complex support, formatting, and bounded errors
acceptance_slices: Tokens parse to an AST (no eval/Function/remote) honoring the six precedence levels including right-associative powers and implicit multiplication
Arithmetic, powers, roots, factorial (0-170), trig with DEG/RAD/GRAD conversion, logs, fractions, and rectangular/polar complex values produce correct typed results

Domain, divide-by-zero, syntax, overflow, and out-of-domain factorial cases return error codes instead of throwing, and the formatter trims to 12 significant digits with scientific-notation thresholds

tasks.title: Implement calculator evaluator
acceptance_slices: The evaluator parses calculator expressions without JavaScript eval or Function and applies required precedence.
Arithmetic, scientific functions, fractions, complex values, and angle conversion return supported values.
Syntax, domain, divide-by-zero, factorial, and overflow failures return calculator errors without exceptions.
